name: sh.clearfront/clearfront
description: OSINT sweep of a digital footprint: breaches, accounts, data brokers, domains and IPs

environmentVariables.name: HIBP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Have I Been Pwned API key, enables breach and paste lookups

environmentVariables.name: IPINFO_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: ipinfo.io token, enables IP geolocation and exposure reports

environmentVariables.name: SHODAN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Shodan API key, enables internet-exposed device lookups

environmentVariables.name: VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: VirusTotal API key, enables reputation checks on IPs, domains, URLs and file hashes

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key, only needed for the AI-assisted multi-target sweep tool
